home.title: Outpost Builder
home.objective: Grow your outpost. Keep your crew supplied. Get ready for what comes next.
top.honesty: Real NASA records. Simple outpost model.
building.sun.name: Solar panel
building.batt.name: Battery
building.o2.name: Oxygen maker
building.farm.name: Greenhouse
building.home.name: Habitat
building.mine.name: Ice mine
building.dig.name: Soil digger
building.fab.name: Parts factory
building.pad.name: Landing pad
building.shelter.name: Soil shelter
building.sun.about: Costs {parts} part. Makes {sun} power a day in sunlight. It cannot go under a shelter.
building.batt.about: Costs {parts} parts. Stores up to {storage} spare power for later.
building.o2.about: Costs {parts} parts. Uses {power} power. Makes {air} air a day.
building.farm.about: Costs {parts} parts. Uses {power} power ({powerSheltered} under a shelter) and {water} water. Makes {food} food and {air} air a day.
building.home.about: Costs {parts} parts. Uses {power} power. Brings {crew} more crew. It cannot be removed.
building.mine.about: Costs {parts} parts. Uses {power} power. Makes {water} water a day. It goes on ice.
building.dig.about: Costs {parts} parts. Uses {power} power. Makes {soil} soil a day. It goes on rock.
building.fab.about: Costs {parts} parts. Uses {power} power. Turns up to {runs} soil into parts each day.
building.pad.about: The supply rocket lands here. It cannot be moved.
building.shelter.about: Costs {soil} soil. Covers {tiles} tiles and blocks radiation. Solar panels and the landing pad cannot go under it.
build.title: Build
build.howTo: Tap a building, then tap the map.
build.lockedTap: Finish this goal to unlock it: {goal}
reason.locked: Finish a goal to unlock this.
reason.not_revealed: That land is not surveyed yet.
reason.need_ice: An ice mine must go on ice.
reason.need_rock: A soil digger must go on rock.
reason.cannot_be_sheltered: Solar panels cannot go under a shelter.
reason.cannot_cover: A shelter cannot cover a solar panel or the landing pad.
place.shelterHere: Tap to place the shelter here
place.wasteIce: This tile has ice. Building here uses it up. Tap again to build.
place.wasteRock: This tile has rock. Building here uses it up. Tap again to build.
goal.label: Your next goal
goal.starter.1: Make air. Build an oxygen maker.
goal.starter.2: Grow food. Build an ice mine and a greenhouse.
goal.starter.3: Dig soil. Build a soil digger.
goal.starter.4: Take cover. Build a soil shelter over your habitat.
goal.stores: Fill your stores: {n} air and {n} food
weather.title: Space weather
remove.ask: Remove it? You get nothing back.
notes.title: Sol {n} is over
notes.rocketBlocked: The supply rocket could not land. The landing pad is broken.
mc.warnStorm: A radiation storm reaches you tomorrow. Put your habitat and machines under soil shelters today.
mc.warnRising: Radiation rises tomorrow. Keep your habitat under a shelter.
mc.blackout: No message from Earth today. Yesterday's solar flare blocked the radio.
mc.radiationHurt: Radiation hurt your crew yesterday. Put a shelter over your habitat.
mc.habitatNoPower: Your habitat had no power yesterday, and your crew lost health. Build a solar panel.
mc.brokeOne: The storm broke your {name} yesterday. It will be back tomorrow.
mc.brokeMany: The storm broke your {name} yesterday. It will be back in {n} days.
mc.rocketBlocked: The supply rocket could not land yesterday. Your landing pad was broken.
mc.noPower: Your {name} had no power yesterday. Build another solar panel.
mc.noWater: Your {name} had no water yesterday. An ice mine makes water.
mc.noSoil: Your {name} had no soil yesterday. A soil digger makes soil.
mc.airFalling: Your air went down yesterday. An oxygen maker makes more air.
mc.foodFalling: Your food went down yesterday. A greenhouse makes more food.
mc.goalDone: Great work! Your goal is done. A new goal is waiting.
mc.goalReady: You did it! End the day to finish your goal.
mc.shelterBlocked: A solar panel is in the way of the shelter. Remove it first.
mc.goal.o2: Your crew needs air. Build an oxygen maker next to your base.
mc.goal.mine: Build an ice mine on an ice tile. It makes water.
mc.goal.farm: Now build a greenhouse. It makes food.
mc.goal.dig: Build a soil digger on a rock tile. It makes soil.
mc.goal.shelter: Build a soil shelter over your habitat. I marked a good spot.
mc.tip.power: More machines need more power. Solar panels make power.
mc.tip.battery: Batteries keep spare power for later.
mc.tip.shelter: Machines under a shelter are safe from radiation. Solar panels must stay outside.
mc.tip.rocket: The supply rocket brings parts every {n} sols.
mc.tip.stock: Watch the numbers under air and food. They show tomorrow.
lost.title: Your crew had to stop here
lost.body: Every outpost teaches you something. What will you try next time?
confirm.newSiteBody: This outpost will be gone. You start fresh on new land.
chapterEnd.title: These records have ended
chapterEnd.body: That was every day of this chapter's NASA records. Your outpost is still here.
